## About
Auto Masters Body & Paint is a family-owned and operated shop on Oneill Ave in Belmont. We handle auto body and collision repair, bumpers, paint and color matching, and we work with all insurance companies and process the claims for you.
Ask for George. Google reviewers mention him by name for honest estimates, calm service and walking them around the car to show the finished work. The shop holds a 4.7 rating from 32 Google reviews.
Nobody plans on needing a body shop. We try to make it convenient and stress-free, with towing, rental car service and pickup and delivery when you need them.

## Services
- Collision repair: Auto body and collision repair to bring your car back to its pre-loss condition.
- Bumper repair and replacement: Fixing or replacing damaged bumpers.
- Paint and color matching: Paint work matched to the rest of your vehicle, as one reviewer described after a door repair.
- Towing, rental car and pickup: We can tow your car in, set you up with a rental, and offer pickup and delivery.
- Fleet work: Body and paint work for business fleets.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No, estimates are free. We also offer pickup and drop off shuttle service.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, the shop is closed Saturday and Sunday. Stop by or call during the week.
